Title: Legs Relief Support Pair

Firm pressure, right under the arch. Held until morning.

Legs Relief is a deep-pressure foot wrap for restless, fidgety legs at night. A firm, contoured pad sits under each arch, and a soft woven-elastic band crosses in an X over the top of your foot to hold it snug. That steady pressure gives your legs something calm to focus on, so you can stop fidgeting and finally drift off.

Why it helps

  • Targeted arch pressure. The firm pad presses right where it counts: the middle of the sole.
  • Criss-cross hold. The X-shaped wrap keeps the pressure in place all night, even when you turn over.
  • Made for sleep. Low-profile and breathable, with toes and heel left open so your feet stay cool.
  • Drug-free. No pills, no prescription, no side effects.

  • 2 firm, removable arch pads
